title: OAuthLib: Token grants can use attacker-supplied client_id for authorization after authenticating a different client…
description: OAuthlib contains a vulnerability in its token grant handlers where an authenticated client can supply a different client_id in the token request body, causing authorization checks to be performed under that other client identity. This affects the client_credentials and password grant flows when the application validator uses the client_id argument for authorization. The flaw allows a lower-privilege client to obtain tokens with broader scopes or grant types assigned to another client. The issue arises because OAuthlib does not require the authenticated client's client_id to match the client_id parameter in the request body during grant and scope validation.
